Sweet Flavor

Rice Syrup

About This Entry

Rice syrup (brown rice syrup) is made by fermenting cooked rice into a mild, nutty-sweet syrup less intensely sweet than cane or corn syrups — that gentleness pairs with Riesling.

Wine Pairing Explanation

Primary wine styles

  • riesling

Common Culinary Uses
